pain.label: a familiar picture
pain.title: Students in a notebook, debts in Excel, «who paid?» in chats.
pain.text: The more students you have, the more tabs. You forget to mark, lose track, miscalculate. Your evening goes to reconciling spreadsheets, not preparing lessons.
pain.solution: Peravenor ties it together: mark attendance and the register, the balance and the stats update themselves.
pain.note: and all this — for a single group

features.label: what it does
features.title: What it looks like from the inside
features.r1title: Set the schedule once — the lessons appear on their own
features.r1p1: Create a group, set the schedule — lessons for 3 months ahead are generated automatically.
features.r1p2: Each lesson has a topic, description, materials (links/text) and a video-call link.
features.r1p3: A group has a link to an external chat (Telegram/WhatsApp) — the student joins in one click.
features.r2title: You mark it — the student confirms
features.r2p1: You mark presence with checkboxes. The student confirms on their side — disputes are highlighted.
features.r2p2: The lesson fee is added to the balance automatically at the group's price.
features.r2p3: For students without an account, the mark counts instantly — solo tracking with no extra steps.
features.r3p1: An assignment for a specific lesson with a deadline (group or individual).
features.r3p2: The student submits a file (or just a comment) right in the app.
features.r3p3: Grade 0–100, visible to the student; everything in one list with statuses.
features.r4title: The balance calculates itself — from attendance
features.r4p1: Balance = charged (attendance) − paid. Per student and per teacher.
features.r4p2: Record a payment manually (cash/transfer) — the balance recalculates instantly.
features.r4p3: Overpayment doesn't go negative — you see the real picture.
features.attNote: The student confirms on their side — disputes show up instantly.
features.finNote: Calculated from attendance — nothing to reconcile by hand.
features.subtitle: Five things that usually live in different places. Here they are connected: mark attendance and the balance updates itself.
features.r1text: Set the schedule once — three months of lessons are created for you. A duplicate on the same date and time simply won't be accepted.
features.r2text: The register works like a school diary: students across, dates down. A tick immediately becomes a charge at the group's price.
features.r3text: One list with statuses instead of a chat thread. You can see who hasn't submitted, who is late and what is waiting to be graded.
features.r4text: No monthly spreadsheets. Charged minus paid, per student, always up to date.
features.r5title: AI prepares the material, you check it
features.r5text: A quiz on a topic and level is built in a minute and lands in your library. From there you assign it like any other task.
features.r5p1: A quiz by topic and difficulty — saved to your library and assigned as homework.
features.r5p2: Open answers are graded by AI; the final score is computed on the server, so it cannot be faked.
features.r5p3: When a student shares a track, you generate a quiz aimed at their weak subtopics.
features.aiQ1: What percentage of a whole is 3/8?
features.aiQ2: A price rises by 20%, then falls by 20%. What happened to it?

whyUs.label: what you get
whyUs.title: Four workplaces of yours — now one
whyUs.subtitle: An attendance notebook, a folder of files, a spreadsheet with money and an evening of prep. All of it here, and all of it connected.
whyUs.c1d: Attendance with confirmation, grades, progress and a card per student: which groups, what was submitted, how much is owed. You see who is falling behind before it becomes a problem.
whyUs.c2d: Lessons, files, links, quizzes and notes are attached to the lesson and the group. Nothing gets lost in a chat thread, and the history stays with you even after a student leaves.
whyUs.c3d: The balance is charged automatically from attendance, payments go through review, invoices print in one click. You always know who owes what, without a single spreadsheet.
whyUs.c4d: Quiz generation by topic and level, grading of open answers, flashcards and targeted tasks aimed at one student’s weak subtopics. Prep takes minutes, not an evening.

faq.label: frequently asked
faq.title: About the platform, in short
faq.subtitle: Answers to the questions that come up before signing up.
faq.note: Still have questions? Sign up and try it — it's free and takes a couple of minutes.
faq.a1: A teacher's workspace. Groups, schedule, lessons, homework, attendance and finances — in one place, instead of a dozen tabs, chats and spreadsheets. You always see who owes what, what's assigned and who submitted, who was in class. If they wish, a student gets a personal portal with schedule, grades, materials and progress.
faq.a2: The basic plan is free — enough to run your first students. For unlimited work there's the Pro plan. Subscription payments are coming soon; for now the limits don't block your work.
faq.q3: Can I run it solo, without student sign-ups?
faq.a3: Yes. Add a student as an entry — just a name and contact, without their involvement. Run the schedule and attendance, the balance is calculated automatically. When needed, the history can be moved to the student's personal account without losing data.
faq.q4: Where does it work and do I need to install anything?
faq.a4: In any browser — on a computer, tablet and phone. Nothing to install. If you wish, the app can be added to your phone's home screen (PWA).
faq.q5: Do I need technical skills or my own website?
faq.a5: No. Signing up and working require no setup, coding or a website of your own. The interface is clear from the first visit.
faq.q6: Are the teacher's and students' data safe?
faq.a6: Yes. Each teacher sees only their own — their groups, their students and their finances. Data is isolated; access to others' information is impossible.
faq.a7: In a few minutes. Signing up takes about a minute; then you create a group or add a student — and start teaching right away.

student.heroSubtitle: Schedule, homework, grades and balance, straight on your phone. Plus your own studying: your topics, AI quizzes, vocabulary and progress. Even if your teacher is not on the platform.
student.painTitle: Your studies scattered across ten places
student.pain1: The assignment is somewhere in the chat, the deadline comes to mind at the last moment
student.pain2: «What's my grade?» — you have to ask every time
student.pain3: The lesson link gets lost in the chat
student.pain4: «How much do I owe?» — you both count it from messages
student.painSolution: All of it — in one portal, where you instantly see what to do and when.
student.f1text: What's assigned, by when and where to submit — in one list. You submit a file or a comment, and see the grade and the teacher's feedback right there.
student.f2text: No more «how much do I owe?». What's charged for lessons and what's paid is calculated automatically, the balance is visible anytime. You can send a payment with a screenshot right in the app.
student.f3text: The teacher marks presence, and you confirm or dispute it. Disputed marks are visible to both sides — no misunderstandings.
student.short1d: All lessons and lesson links — nothing gets lost.
student.short2d: Personal progress, lesson materials, notes and vocabulary — in one portal.
student.short3d: Works in the browser — nothing to install.
student.short4d: The student portal is free. You only pay for lessons — to the teacher.
student.step1d: Student account: name, email, password. About a minute.
student.step2d: The teacher finds you by username (@username) and sends an invitation to the group — you accept it.
student.step3d: Then it's all at hand: schedule, assignments, grades, attendance, balance, materials and progress.
student.sq1: What does Peravenor give a student?
student.sa1: All your studies in one place: schedule with lesson links, homework with deadlines, grades, attendance and balance. Plus personal tools — learning progress, lesson materials, notes and vocabulary. No need to scroll chats and remember what's assigned and when the lesson is.
student.sq2: Is it paid for the student?
student.sa2: The student portal is free. You pay the teacher for the lessons themselves, and the platform shows how much is charged and paid. You can send a payment right in the app with a confirmation — the teacher approves it.
student.sq3: Do I need to install an app?
student.sa3: No. Everything works in the browser on your phone and computer. If you wish, the app can be added to your home screen (PWA).
student.sq4: How do I sign up and get to my teacher?
student.sa4: Signing up takes about a minute. The teacher finds you by username (@username) and sends an invitation to the group — you accept it, and you're all set.
student.sq5: Can I use it without a teacher?
student.sa5: Yes. Even without a teacher you run your own learning: add your topics and subjects, take tests, track progress, keep a vocabulary and notes, log lessons and payments. And if you have a teacher — you also see their schedule, assignments and grades.
student.sq6: Can I study with several teachers?
student.sa6: Yes. One account brings together all your teachers, groups and individual lessons.
student.sa7: Yes. The teacher sees only what's related to your lessons. Access to your data by outsiders is impossible.
